details: Cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and Ether rallied as global geopolitical tensions eased following a U.S. Senate vote on presidential war powers. This positive sentiment was further bolstered by President Trump's directive for the Federal Reserve to investigate payment services access for crypto firms. This move is seen as a potential step towards greater integration of crypto into traditional finance, which could enhance institutional confidence and liquidity in the crypto market.
title: Geopolitical Calm & Fed's Crypto Payment Review Boost Markets

details: The S&P 500 is on track for its eighth consecutive weekly gain, primarily driven by the ongoing rally in AI and technology stocks. Despite this, Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller indicated that the central bank's next interest rate adjustment could be a hike rather than a cut, with market participants now fully pricing in a rate increase by December. This outlook comes amidst a notable decline in U.S. consumer sentiment, attributed to persistent inflation concerns and geopolitical conflicts.
title: S&P 500 Rallies on AI, Fed Governor Signals Potential Rate Hike
